poses.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied TRANSPARENT Japanese woodblock tornado CLOUD LAYER, not a full scene. Make animation pose 2 of a five-pose rotating funnel. The painted cloud mass has advanced approximately 72 degrees around its VERTICAL tornado axis: redraw the actual broad curling cloud bands and inner turbulent brush patterns to show that next rotation view. Do NOT rotate or tilt the canvas or turn the tornado sideways. The cloud crown remains broad, the funnel points down in the identical position, its narrow lower tip anchored at exactly the same place. Keep the full original silhouette, upper-cloud coverage, original proportions, composition, original exact muted blue/grey/ivory print palette, paper grain and scale as closely as possible. This should be a credible next view of the same rotating cloudy funnel, not stretching, mirroring, horizontal smearing, sinusoidal distortion, added motion streaks, gradients, shiny highlights or a shading-only overlay. Preserve the rough printed edges and cohesive hand-painted cloud curls. Keep all scenery, sky, leaves, water and architecture absent. Everything outside the cloud/tornado must be genuinely transparent. Same full tall 4:9 canvas and original placement; do not recenter or enlarge. ONE single-frame RGBA cloud-only image; no montage, spritesheet, filmstrip, text or border.
